idea-plugin.name: XLS Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Read-only XLS/XLSX viewer with workbook diff.

Opens Excel workbooks (.xls, Excel 97-2003, and .xlsx) and renders them the way Excel does: fonts, fills, borders, alignment, text wrapping, merged cells, frozen panes, row heights, column widths, number formats, theme colors and colored sheet tabs. Two workbooks can be compared side by side with change markers, and unchanged rows and columns can be collapsed.
